title: A scheme receiving a surjective universally closed morphism from an affine scheme is affine
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that $X$ is an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], that $f$ is surjective, i.e. the map of underlying topological spaces $|X|\to|S|$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and that $f$ is universally closed, i.e. for every morphism $S'\to S$ the base change $X\times_SS'\to S'$ is a closed map of underlying topological spaces [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Then $S$ is an affine scheme. (In particular this holds when $f$ is surjective and integral, an integral morphism being universally closed.)
